claims.statement: The aggregated battery record identifies Sanyo UR18650F as a flat-top, unprotected 18650 cell; it is a low-drain cell and remains unsuitable for high-current vaping use.
Steam Engine preserves Sanyo UR18650F 2400mAh 1C as a 2400mAh preset with a 1C runtime rating.
Sanyo UR18650F is documented as lithium-ion; an older TI chemistry association reports LCO for the UR18650F family, but the exact catalog revision was not established.
The exact catalog entry Sanyo UR18650F has reliable market-introduction evidence dated 2011-12-24 or earlier.
